collection.name: D&D Spell Quick Reference
collection.description: Concise spell reference organized by spell level with role and tag filtering.

roles.name: Defense
roles.description: Prevents, mitigates, redirects, or avoids harm.

roles.name: Control
roles.description: Restricts creatures or reshapes the battlefield.

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Buffs, protects, communicates with, or otherwise assists allies.

roles.name: Mobility
roles.description: Repositions creatures or enables unusual movement.

roles.name: Healing
roles.description: Restores hit points, removes harmful effects, or returns creatures to life.

roles.name: Utility
roles.description: Exploration, information, preparation, and other non-damage solutions.

normalizationNotes: The primary site hierarchy is spell level; roles and tags are filters, not display categories.
primaryRole provides one stable visual classification while roles supports multi-role filtering.
Tags describe mechanics, themes, movement, planar relevance, and other secondary characteristics.
Summoning is represented as a tag rather than a primary role.
Redundant isCantrip, image:null, and the old categories array were removed.
This is a concise quick reference rather than reproduced full spell rules. Optional mechanics are included only when present in the source data.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.summary: Acid hits one or two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.summary: Enhances a melee weapon attack with thunder damage.
notes: The source entry was incomplete and only specified '+1d8 thunder damage scaling'.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.summary: Basic ranged fire attack.

spells.name: Light
spells.summary: Causes an object to emit light.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.summary: Creates a telekinetic hand.

spells.name: Mending
spells.summary: Repairs an object.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.summary: Creates an image or sound illusion.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.summary: Performs minor magical tricks.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.summary: Reduces the target's speed by 10 feet.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.summary: Radiant flame descends on a creature and ignores cover.
notes: The earlier source row listed fire damage and an attack roll. The later radiant/DEX-save entry was used as canonical.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.summary: Makes a lightning attack and prevents the target from taking reactions.
notes: The source notes did not include the base damage formula.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.summary: Stabilizes a dying creature.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.summary: Deals more damage if the target is already wounded.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.summary: Restores hit points.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.summary: Detects the presence of magic and can reveal its school.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.summary: Creates heavy obscurement.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.summary: The next attack against the target has advantage.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.summary: Restores hit points at range.

spells.name: Identify
spells.summary: Reveals a magic item's properties or the spells affecting a creature or object.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.summary: Sets Armor Class to 13 + Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.summary: Protects a creature against several supernatural creature types and makes certain charms, fright, and possession harder to maintain.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.summary: Deals damage and may inflict the poisoned condition.
spells.saveOrAttack: Spell attack followed by CON save

spells.name: Shield
spells.summary: Reaction that grants +5 Armor Class.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.summary: Grants +2 Armor Class.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.summary: Puts creatures to sleep based on an affected hit-point pool.
spells.scaling: +2d8 affected hit points per slot level above 1

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.summary: Pushes creatures away.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.summary: Blinds or deafens the target for up to 1 minute.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.summary: Reads surface thoughts.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.summary: Pushes creatures away.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.summary: Paralyzes a humanoid.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.summary: Creates illusory duplicates.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.summary: Bonus-action teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.summary: Restores hit points with a 10-minute casting time.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.summary: Halves Strength-based weapon damage.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.summary: Creates multiple fire rays.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.summary: Lets the caster see invisible creatures and objects, and perceive into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Vortex Warp
spells.summary: Teleports another creature to an unoccupied space within range; unwilling targets can resist.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.summary: Raises a skeleton or zombie.

spells.name: Blink
spells.summary: The caster repeatedly slips into the Ethereal Plane, making them difficult to target between turns.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.summary: Interrupts another creature's spell.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.summary: Ends magical effects.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.summary: Classic 20-foot-radius explosion.

spells.name: Fly
spells.summary: Grants a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.summary: Stores a magical ward that triggers under conditions you define.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.summary: Creates a 5-foot-wide lightning line.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.summary: Creates a ward that can protect against or contain certain extraplanar creatures.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.summary: Restores hit points to as many as six creatures.
spells.healing: 1d4 + spellcasting modifier to up to 6 creatures

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.summary: Prevents divination magic from detecting the target.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.summary: Grants resistance to one chosen common energy damage type.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.summary: Returns a creature that died moments ago to life.

spells.name: Sending
spells.summary: Sends a brief message to a known creature at any distance, with reduced reliability across planes.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.summary: Ask a corpse five questions; it answers based on what it knew in life.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.summary: Creates a damaging aura around the caster.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.summary: Summons a ghostly, skeletal, or putrid undead spirit.

spells.name: Thunder Step
spells.summary: Teleport away in a thunderous burst; nearby creatures at the departure point can take thunder damage.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.summary: The caster heals for half the damage dealt.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.summary: Creates an invisible magical sensor that can scout ahead and relay what it sees.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.summary: Sends the target to another plane. Extraplanar targets may be banished permanently after 1 minute; native targets return when the spell ends.

spells.name: Blight
spells.summary: Massive necrotic damage; plants take maximum damage.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.summary: Protects a creature from one effect that would drop it to 0 hit points or kill it outright.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.summary: Teleports you, and optionally one willing creature, to a location within range.

spells.name: Divination
spells.summary: Seeks a truthful omen about a specific goal, event, or activity in the near future.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.summary: Helps a creature ignore several magical restrictions on movement and escape restraints.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.summary: Makes a creature invisible even while attacking.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.summary: Creates an icy storm over an area.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
spells.summary: Wards an area against surveillance, teleportation, and planar intrusion.

spells.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
spells.summary: Encloses a creature in a force sphere that blocks effects through its boundary.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.summary: Creates psychic terror that can deal damage each round.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.summary: Hardens a creature's body against nonmagical weapon damage.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.summary: Animates objects so they can attack enemies.

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.summary: Creates a moving poison cloud.

spells.name: Commune
spells.summary: Asks a deity or divine proxy a small number of questions and receives brief truthful answers.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.summary: Contacts an extraplanar entity to ask questions, with a risk of psychic strain.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.summary: Inflicts a magical disease.

spells.name: Danse Macabre
spells.summary: Raises five undead with attack bonuses.

spells.name: Dawn
spells.summary: Creates a cylinder of radiant light.

spells.name: Dream
spells.summary: Reaches a sleeping creature through dreams for communication or, in hostile use, psychic distress.

spells.name: Far Step
spells.summary: For the duration, teleport up to 60 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.summary: Creates a pillar of fire and radiant energy.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.summary: Ends one major debilitating effect such as a curse, petrification, or certain ability or hit-point reductions.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.summary: Consecrates a large area with a lasting ward and a chosen supernatural effect.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.summary: Reveals lore about a person, place, or object of legendary importance.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.summary: Restores hit points to as many as six creatures.
spells.healing: 3d8 + spellcasting modifier to up to 6 creatures

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.summary: Attempts to bind certain extraplanar creatures into service for an extended duration.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.summary: Returns a creature that has been dead for a limited time to life, with recovery penalties.

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.summary: Returns a dead humanoid to life in a newly formed body.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.summary: Magically observes a creature or location at great distance; the target can resist.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.summary: Deals psychic damage and applies a mental debuff.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.summary: Creates a temporary portal to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.summary: Creates an invisible, effectively indestructible barrier.

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.summary: Creates two linked portals that creatures can move through in either direction.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.summary: Huge necrotic explosion with a 60-foot radius.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.summary: Stores a qualifying spell to trigger automatically when a chosen circumstance occurs.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.summary: Creates ghouls, ghasts, or wights; higher slots can create stronger undead such as mummies.
spells.scaling: More or stronger undead at higher slot levels

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.summary: Reduces a creature to dust at 0 HP and can destroy objects or walls.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.summary: Each round, inflicts magical sleep, panic, or sickness on a target.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.summary: Reveals the most direct physical route to a known fixed destination on the same plane.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.summary: Wards a large area against planar travel and can harm selected supernatural creature types.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.summary: Blocks spells of 5th level or lower.

spells.name: Harm
spells.summary: Drastically reduces hit points and limits maximum HP until healed.

spells.name: Heal
spells.summary: Restores a large fixed amount of hit points instantly.

spells.name: Heroes' Feast
spells.summary: Creates a supernatural feast that strengthens a group and grants several long-duration protections.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.summary: Repositions up to five creatures to spaces you can see within 120 feet; unwilling creatures can resist.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.summary: Traps a dying soul for advantages or healing.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.summary: Creates a radiant beam that can blind undead.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.summary: Grants truesight, reveals hidden forms, and allows sight into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.summary: Instantly returns the caster and nearby willing creatures to a previously designated sanctuary.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.summary: Moves the caster into the Border Ethereal, allowing travel through many creatures and objects.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.summary: A humanoid killed by the spell rises as a zombie servant.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.summary: Creates a powerful invisible prison of force that is extremely difficult to escape.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
spells.summary: Creates a secure extradimensional dwelling suitable for sheltering a large group.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.summary: Transports willing creatures to another plane, or can attempt to banish an unwilling creature there.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.summary: Returns a dead creature to life.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.summary: Instantly transports the caster and companions to a destination on the same plane; accuracy depends on familiarity.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.summary: Creates an area where most magic is suppressed.

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.summary: Creates or reconnects to an extradimensional chamber through a shadowy door.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.summary: Controls a creature.

spells.name: Feeblemind
spells.summary: Reduces Intelligence and Charisma to 1, crippling thought and spellcasting.

spells.name: Maze
spells.summary: Temporarily banishes a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane until it escapes.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.summary: Provides powerful long-duration protection from psychic harm, mind reading, divination, and mental influence.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.summary: Creates a massive radiant explosion.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.summary: Projects the party's astral forms into the Astral Plane for long-range planar travel.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.summary: Grants extraordinary supernatural awareness and combat advantage for an extended duration.

spells.name: Gate
spells.summary: Opens a portal to a precise location on another plane and can call a specific creature by name.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.summary: The target dies instantly if it has 100 hit points or fewer.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.summary: Returns a long-dead creature to life and can restore a missing body.

spells.name: Wish
spells.summary: The most powerful general-purpose spell, capable of duplicating lower-level spells and producing extraordinary effects.
